rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for describing doing something in this way or manner.

example.english: If you do it thus, it’ll be right.
example.jyutping: nei5 gam2 joeng6 zou6 zau6 ngaam1 laa3

rows.note: Use this to introduce a result or conclusion, meaning “therefore” or “so.”

example.english: It’s raining, thus I’m staying in.
example.jyutping: lok6 gan2 jyu5 so2 ji5 ngo5 m4 ceot1 gaai1
